svm_rbf.architecture: StandardScaler + RBF-kernel SVM (class-balanced) with sigmoid probability calibration

mlp.architecture: StandardScaler + MLP (1 hidden layer, 128 ReLU units, Adam, L2, early stopping), class-balanced by oversampling

gru.architecture: Temporal model: per-frame linear embedding (96) -> bidirectional GRU (96 per direction) -> mean+max pooling + global motion features -> linear softmax; AdamW, class-weighted loss, early stopping on a held-out split of training samples (PyTorch, CPU)

evaluation_strategy: StratifiedGroupKFold over signer/session groups (2 folds) on development data
headline_source: independent test set (held-out signer/session group(s): nachiketh, signer_0403)
